components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action on light operational surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 18px; background: var(--ink, #17202a); color: var(--white, #ffffff); font: 850 14px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-soft, #263342); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #d9ff43); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Routing Button
components.description: The single high-energy action on an ink-dark surface.
components.css: .ds-button-accent { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 18px; background: var(--accent, #d9ff43); color: var(--ink, #17202a); font: 850 14px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-accent:hover { background: var(--accent-deep, #b9e22d); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-accent:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A stable 48px form field with visible focus and no layout shift.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink, #17202a); font: 800 13px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #aeb5b4; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--white, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #17202a); padding: 12px 13px; font: 400 16px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ink, #17202a); outline: 3px solid rgba(217, 255, 67, .8); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Route Label
components.description: Identifies an item, service boundary, or current route without becoming decorative.
components.css: .ds-route-label { display: inline-block; color: #4c5864; font: 900 11px/1.4 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Quantity Stepper
components.description: A compact cart control with explicit decrement, value, and increment targets.
components.css: .ds-stepper { min-height: 46px; display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 38px 42px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd3cf); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--white, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #17202a); } .ds-stepper button { height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-size: 18px; } .ds-stepper button:hover { background: #e8eae5; } .ds-stepper button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #d9ff43); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-stepper output { text-align: center; font-weight: 800; }

narrative.overview: Vin Shop borrows the clarity of a well-run dispatch desk and the confidence of a contemporary product catalogue. Large product photography and decisive type create desire; routing marks, compact identifiers, and crisp status language quietly suggest that every action has a destination. The system is energetic without becoming playful.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width visual anchors with restrained copy.
Ink-dark structural surfaces against clean paper-like content fields.
One electric routing accent used for action and state.
Square, directional composition softened only where touch ergonomics require it.
Motion communicates arrival, routing, and state change.

rules.name: The Routing Mark Rule
rules.body: The accent marks a destination, selection, or successful state; it is never scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The One Poster Rule
rules.body: Only one message per viewport earns display scale; all supporting language remains compact.

dos: Use real product imagery and make its crop intentional.
Make loading, empty, error, disabled, and success states visible.
Let alignment and scale create hierarchy before adding containers.
Preserve familiar commerce affordances even when the composition is distinctive.
donts: Build the page from a mosaic of equal rounded cards.
Use gradients, glass, glow, or decorative grids as a substitute for product content.
Put marketing language inside admin or operational surfaces.
Repeat uppercase eyebrow labels over every section.
Invent stock, shipping, customer, pricing, or performance claims.
